instruction: Build a tiny Vite React counter app. The first screen must show the heading LLM validation counter, a visible count starting at 0, and a button labeled Increment. Clicking Increment must increase the visible count by 1 without navigation. Put the integer count inside an element with data-testid="count-value" and no extra text. Put data-testid="increment-button" on the Increment button.

metadata.expected_behavior: The generated app should show a counter initialized to 0 and increment it when the Increment button is clicked.
